target_generation.secret_scalar: one nonzero k per endpoint, sealed from collector

factor_bases.native: first B distinct rational abscissae in increasing integer order, both signed points
factor_bases.random_control: same signed cardinality, independently seeded random rational points on the same endpoint
factor_bases.isomorphic_control: u=2; map x to u^2 x and y to u^3 y, with a to u^4 a and b to u^6 b

relation.raw_conservation: sum over all group targets of ordered triple multiplicity equals |F|^3
relation.useful_triple: three distinct point IDs, no opposite pair, canonical nonzero row
relation.row_columns: one per factor-base abscissa after sign folding, plus one common Q column
relation.primary_metric: fraction of attempted targets with at least one verified useful triple

analysis.within_pair_contrast: log(floor useful occupancy / crater useful occupancy)
analysis.interval: 99% finite-population or conservative two-sample target-sampling interval
analysis.lead_rule: both valid pair intervals exclude ratio 1 in same direction; each point ratio differs from 1 by at least 20%; controls pass; rank usefulness does not reverse
